items.expected_conclusion: The submission supports a conclusion about relative stability and population only within the three required distinct conformers and states that the absent SI conformers prevent a full-ensemble claim.
items.statement: The three named conformers are chemically distinct validated minima with consistent relative Gibbs energies at 298.15 K. Their ordering and populations are evaluated using normalization over those three members; additional conformers may be reported separately.
